title: Structure of the First Installment of a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease End-of-Term Plan
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — how the first plan installment is built against the total monthly payment**

**Clause.** The shape of the first installment follows the plan balance:

- when the plan balance exceeds 2 times the lease's total monthly payment (the large-plan payment count), the first installment is one total monthly payment as a down payment plus the rest of the plan balance divided by the plan's number of installments;
- when the plan balance is no more than one total monthly payment, the first installment is the whole plan balance;
- in every other case, it is the plan balance divided by the plan's number of installments.

The plan setup fee is added last, to the amount this shape gives.

The plan balance is the end-of-term charges billed for the turn-in less the security deposit applied and less every end-of-term payment posted.

**Worked figures (hypothetical: total monthly payment $450.00, plan of 4 installments, before the setup fee)**

| Plan balance | Band | First installment before the setup fee |
|---|---|---|
| $2250.00 | above $900.00 | $450.00 plus $1800.00 divided by 4, that is $900.00 |
| $900.00 | above $450.00, not above $900.00 | $900.00 divided by 4, that is $225.00 |
| $700.00 | above $450.00, not above $900.00 | $700.00 divided by 4, that is $175.00 |
| $450.00 | not above $450.00 | the whole $450.00 |
| $300.00 | not above $450.00 | the whole $300.00 |
